title: Man's Dependence on Allah
summary: Humans are inherently needy and depend on Allah's mercy.
translation: A human being's nature is that they are entirely in need. In any situation, they lack the power to accomplish anything on their own. The reality is that when a person turns to Allah, asks from Allah, and pleads with Him, Allah arranges all matters for them. Therefore, the essence of a human is that they are inherently in need. It is merely their delusion to think they can achieve their goals through their own planning and reach their destination. The truth is, Allah Almighty is the true doer, and all human efforts are merely a means to attract Allah's mercy. Just like a compassionate father feels for his small child who attempts to walk, seeing them fall repeatedly, knowing they cannot reach their goal through their own strength, he eventually extends his finger to help them reach their destination. Similarly, our beloved Sustainer shows mercy and helps us reach our goals that we cannot reach on our own. And if the child acknowledges their helplessness, sheds tears, and looks towards their father while calling in a trembling voice, the father's heart fills with love, and he immediately picks up the child. This is also true of our Merciful, Generous Sustainer, who, hearing the cries, pleas, and prayers from the hearts of His servants, promptly pays attention, and His divine mercy fulfills our desires. Allah, in the Holy Quran, commands His servants, 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you.' Therefore, one should strive with eagerness and devotion, and plead with Allah to achieve all their desires. This is the only path where a person can prove themselves entirely devoid of any means, trying to convince themselves that whatever they have is only from Allah. 'O Allah, make this work possible for me, achieve this for me, and grant me favor as You have always favored me.' Therefore, there should be an atmosphere of prayer at home with children, with wives, with relatives, gathering everyone for collective prayers, with eagerness, passion, and regularity.
